k031_public_projection.scope: All 29 public member projections, full shared context, and 15 qualification records. Original private-digest subjects differ from these readable public projections.

members.name: Purpose-fit representation and abstraction
members.residual: Criterion/guidance and existing-owner routing are available; exact receiving behavior and any wider empirical claims remain separately unproved.

reason.source: Retained as a robust criterion/mechanism distinction within the declared trigger; this is not a claim of universally quantified economic benefit. Modelling is preserved as a functional instrument with explicit purpose and limits, not as the entirety of BPM.
reason.target: Purpose-fit representation maps to evidence-boundary, unsupported-use and closure discipline in plan and finding rows.
reason.qualification_limit: Docs do not prove consumers can actually make the intended distinction.

source_transfer_test.REQUIRED_ASSUMPTIONS: An identified consumer and task; a way to test comprehension or analytic/execution adequacy.
source_transfer_test.FAILURE_IF_VIOLATED: A communication sketch is reused as executable truth; a technically exact model is unintelligible to its decision maker.
source_transfer_test.TRANSFER_TEST: What practical test demonstrates adequacy for this consumer without over-specifying the model?

first_missing_discriminator.observable_postcondition: The consumer can make the intended distinction, and prohibited or unsupported uses are visible.
first_missing_discriminator.target_delta: No distinct new guidance beyond existing owners. Inherited conditional obligations remain operative when their actual trigger holds; this grants no runtime or frontier closure.

reconsideration_trigger.source_trigger: A representation is being selected, simplified, shared or reused for a new purpose.
reconsideration_trigger.nontrigger: Use the lightest already-understood representation that preserves the needed distinction; no diagram is required where a short narrative is enough.
reconsideration_trigger.changed_premise: New relevant authority/domain/consumer, changed evidence or absorption/mechanism state. Negative rows require a changed claim/premise and independent source adjudication; rediscovery alone does not revive them.

members.name: Behaviour-preserving complexity management
members.residual: Criterion/guidance and existing-owner routing are available; exact receiving behavior and any wider empirical claims remain separately unproved.

reason.source: The protected comprehension function survives, while formal compliance or complexity thresholds can become counterproductive ceremony. Heuristics become prompts for task-based improvement rather than universal numerical thresholds.
reason.target: Complexity handling is already constrained by cheapest sufficient planning and no ceremony for its own sake; EBPM mainly qualifies overuse.
reason.qualification_limit: No supplied evidence identifies a current complexity failure.

source_transfer_test.REQUIRED_ASSUMPTIONS: A known task and user population; explicit behaviour or meaning to preserve; a comparison with the current representation.
source_transfer_test.FAILURE_IF_VIOLATED: Decomposition hides cross-boundary dependencies; adherence to a size rule increases navigation cost.
source_transfer_test.TRANSFER_TEST: When do multiple views reduce cognitive burden rather than fragment understanding?

first_missing_discriminator.observable_postcondition: Users handle the relevant cases at least adequately without loss of critical constraints or relationships.
first_missing_discriminator.target_delta: none beyond retaining proportionality rationale.

reconsideration_trigger.source_trigger: Users cannot reliably interpret a model, or model changes introduce structural errors.
reconsideration_trigger.nontrigger: Remove an ambiguity or improve a label before imposing a new modelling standard or decomposition programme.
reconsideration_trigger.changed_premise: New relevant authority/domain/consumer, changed evidence or absorption/mechanism state. Negative rows require a changed claim/premise and independent source adjudication; rediscovery alone does not revive them.

members.name: Knowledge-work and declarative alternatives
members.residual: No blanket obligation or implementation qualification. Bind original trigger, assumptions, domain and actual receiving decision before choosing a realisation.

reason.source: A genuine option, not an unconditional requirement; selection depends on the stated trigger, prerequisites and cheaper alternatives. Procedural, case-oriented and declarative forms remain alternatives or bounded hybrids; no universal replacement is asserted.
reason.target: Knowledge-work discretion aligns with cheap-path restraint and OWNER DECISION handling; no distinct product property is evident without a target process needing declarative support.
reason.qualification_limit: Criterion is domain-general and no IMPLEMENTAUDIT case-management gap is supplied.

source_transfer_test.REQUIRED_ASSUMPTIONS: Competent participants; intelligible goals/constraints; usable shared information and a way to recognise unresolved obligations.
source_transfer_test.FAILURE_IF_VIOLATED: Discretion becomes unaccountable; a constraint model is too difficult to understand; supposedly flexible tools impose hidden rigidity.
source_transfer_test.TRANSFER_TEST: What combination of guidance and discretion is sufficient for the competence and risk of this work?

first_missing_discriminator.observable_postcondition: Participants can adapt the work while preserving essential obligations and keeping others informed.
first_missing_discriminator.target_delta: none unless a specific adaptive-work owner is selected.

reconsideration_trigger.source_trigger: Cases require changing knowledge, professional judgement or runtime planning that an exhaustive flow would distort.
reconsideration_trigger.nontrigger: A shared case note, goal list and essential constraints can be enough without a case-management engine.
reconsideration_trigger.changed_premise: New relevant authority/domain/consumer, changed evidence or absorption/mechanism state. Negative rows require a changed claim/premise and independent source adjudication; rediscovery alone does not revive them.

members.name: Selective automation and interface suitability
members.residual: No blanket obligation or implementation qualification. Bind original trigger, assumptions, domain and actual receiving decision before choosing a realisation.

reason.source: A genuine option, not an unconditional requirement; selection depends on the stated trigger, prerequisites and cheaper alternatives. Automation is retained as a conditional means among alternatives, not a measure of BPM maturity.
reason.target: Selective automation is already constrained by affected contracts, evidence applicability, reversibility, authority and outcome comparison instead of tool adoption.
reason.qualification_limit: No automation proposal is supplied.

source_transfer_test.REQUIRED_ASSUMPTIONS: Adequate inputs, known interfaces, operation/support capacity and a meaningful outcome test.
source_transfer_test.FAILURE_IF_VIOLATED: Fragile screen automation, accelerated flawed decisions, hidden exceptions and maintenance cost omitted from benefit claims.
source_transfer_test.TRANSFER_TEST: When do integration and maintenance costs make a seemingly cheap interface robot inferior to organisational repair?

first_missing_discriminator.observable_postcondition: The selected mechanism performs its bounded function under stated conditions, with business consequences evaluated separately.
first_missing_discriminator.target_delta: No distinct new guidance beyond existing owners. Inherited conditional obligations remain operative when their actual trigger holds; this grants no runtime or frontier closure.

reconsideration_trigger.source_trigger: Repetitive digital work or coordination overhead suggests a technical intervention.
reconsideration_trigger.nontrigger: Retain manual work or improve information/organisation when exception cost or integration fragility outweighs automation benefit.
reconsideration_trigger.changed_premise: New relevant authority/domain/consumer, changed evidence or absorption/mechanism state. Negative rows require a changed claim/premise and independent source adjudication; rediscovery alone does not revive them.

members.name: Governed low-code participation and delivery
members.residual: No blanket obligation or implementation qualification. Bind original trigger, assumptions, domain and actual receiving decision before choosing a realisation.

reason.source: Retained for the specified technical/organisational domain; its bounded result must not be promoted into a general BPM obligation. Ease of construction is refined into governed participation, not an assumption that low code removes engineering or organisational obligations.
reason.target: Low-code participation is a domain-specific instance of socio-technical delivery, support authority and outcome evidence; no general new mechanism follows.
reason.qualification_limit: No low-code application or support arrangement supplied.

source_transfer_test.REQUIRED_ASSUMPTIONS: Task-fit language, training/support, bounded data/system access and accountable review of consequential delivery.
source_transfer_test.FAILURE_IF_VIOLATED: Shadow applications, hidden dependencies, unsupported maintenance, overgeneralising developer usability to business-user competence.
source_transfer_test.TRANSFER_TEST: Which delivery scopes can safely be delegated to which users with what support cost?

first_missing_discriminator.observable_postcondition: A delivered application has demonstrated task fit and an identified support/authority arrangement for its real consequences.
first_missing_discriminator.target_delta: none unless low-code delivery is in scope.

reconsideration_trigger.source_trigger: Non-specialists or decentralised teams build applications that affect process operation.
reconsideration_trigger.nontrigger: Use a supported template or existing application; professional development may dominate where risk or integration complexity exceeds local capability.
reconsideration_trigger.changed_premise: New relevant authority/domain/consumer, changed evidence or absorption/mechanism state. Negative rows require a changed claim/premise and independent source adjudication; rediscovery alone does not revive them.

members.name: Consistent declarative constraints and history-compatible change
members.residual: No blanket obligation or implementation qualification. Bind original trigger, assumptions, domain and actual receiving decision before choosing a realisation.

reason.source: Retained for the specified technical/organisational domain; its bounded result must not be promoted into a general BPM obligation. Constraint-based flexibility is retained with explicit composition and change-consistency obligations, separated from the representation-selection property EBPM-016.
reason.target: Formal declarative constraints are a domain-specific evidence type; existing source already limits checked formal results to their encoded scope and authority.
reason.qualification_limit: No formal model bytes or checker result supplied.

source_transfer_test.REQUIRED_ASSUMPTIONS: A defined event alphabet and trace semantics, correct encoding, adequate history and a tractable analysis method.
source_transfer_test.FAILURE_IF_VIOLATED: Omitted obligations; wrong event mapping; satisfiable but harmful behaviour; state-space/constraint complexity; missing actual history.
source_transfer_test.TRANSFER_TEST: How reliably can users author and maintain complete constraints, and how do multi-object or partially observed cases change the guarantees?

first_missing_discriminator.observable_postcondition: Within the checked formal model, the stated consistency/history-compatibility result holds; no claim about unencoded harm or real-world correctness follows.
first_missing_discriminator.target_delta: none unless formal declarative process models are introduced.

reconsideration_trigger.source_trigger: A declarative process has interacting constraints or is changed while cases are in progress.
reconsideration_trigger.nontrigger: For a few transparent constraints, competent manual checking may suffice; procedural or case-based alternatives may be easier for the actual users.
reconsideration_trigger.changed_premise: New relevant authority/domain/consumer, changed evidence or absorption/mechanism state. Negative rows require a changed claim/premise and independent source adjudication; rediscovery alone does not revive them.

members.name: Structured and unstructured model selection
members.residual: No blanket obligation or implementation qualification. Bind original trigger, assumptions, domain and actual receiving decision before choosing a realisation.

reason.source: No universal superiority claim is warranted for either block structure or unrestricted graphs.
reason.target: The target already rejects representation prestige and pseudo-dependencies; structured versus unstructured choice is a qualification on modelling, not product work by itself.
reason.qualification_limit: Navigation projection only; no selected model form is supplied.

source_transfer_test.CRITICAL_ASSUMPTIONS: A semantic equivalence criterion for any transformation, not visual neatness alone.
source_transfer_test.FAILURE_IF_VIOLATED: Expressive behaviour is lost to a tidy diagram, or an unnecessarily general model becomes unanalysable.
source_transfer_test.CHEAPER_DOMINATING_CONTEXT: Use structured blocks where they express the task clearly; keep unstructured behaviour when forced restructuring would obscure or alter it.

first_missing_discriminator.observable_postcondition: The selected form represents the required cases without unexamined semantic translation.
first_missing_discriminator.target_delta: none unless a model interchange/engine representation is introduced.

reconsideration_trigger.source_trigger: Choosing a representation for complex joins, cycles or nested cancellation.
reconsideration_trigger.nontrigger: Use structured blocks where they express the task clearly; keep unstructured behaviour when forced restructuring would obscure or alter it.
reconsideration_trigger.changed_premise: New relevant authority/domain/consumer, changed evidence or absorption/mechanism state. Negative rows require a changed claim/premise and independent source adjudication; rediscovery alone does not revive them.

members.name: Verification by state analysis, reduction and justified composition
members.residual: No blanket obligation or implementation qualification. Bind original trigger, assumptions, domain and actual receiving decision before choosing a realisation.

reason.source: Conditional method; verification must earn its cost and cannot replace environmental evidence.
reason.target: Verifier-plan selection already requires cheapest sufficient decision-changing evidence; formal reduction/state analysis is a higher assurance option.
reason.qualification_limit: No enacted model or formal verdict in input.

source_transfer_test.CRITICAL_ASSUMPTIONS: Property-preserving translation/reduction and declared component interfaces.
source_transfer_test.FAILURE_IF_VIOLATED: A proof about a reduced or component model is incorrectly transferred to the real composition.
source_transfer_test.CHEAPER_DOMINATING_CONTEXT: A reviewed small model or direct test may dominate heavyweight verification for low-risk bounded work.

first_missing_discriminator.observable_postcondition: The verdict can be reproduced and its link to the enacted version explained.
first_missing_discriminator.target_delta: none except where state interaction exceeds reliable direct inspection.

reconsideration_trigger.source_trigger: State interaction is too complex for reliable unaided inspection or consequences justify formal assurance.
